reviews.title: Absolutely unacceptable experience.
reviews.body:
Absolutely unacceptable experience.
My device has been on a Lebara deny list for more than 15 days after activating 5 SIMs within 12 months (their own limit is 4). Because of this I cannot install any new Lebara eSIM or physical SIM. Every QR code I receive says “code is no longer valid.”
Support keeps repeating the same lines: “we’ve escalated it”, “wait 24–48 hours”, “waiting for Vodafone response.” Nothing ever happens. Meanwhile Talkmobile and Voxi eSIMs (both on the same Vodafone network) install and work perfectly on this exact phone. This proves the problem is Lebara’s internal restriction, not a network issue.
I have spent a lot of money on previous Lebara plans and am now left without service on this handset. The constant unfulfilled promises and lack of any real action is extremely poor.
I am raising this as a formal complaint and will escalate to the Communications Ombudsman if the restriction is not cleared and a working eSIM provided urgently.
Lebara – please resolve this properly instead of more empty delays.

reviews.title: I've had a rolling SIM contract for…
reviews.body:
I've had a rolling SIM contract for several years. I do not run a business. Over the weekend of 19th and 20th September I was trying to pay bills, book flights and hotels. It was also the date my rolling SIM renewed. Upon trying to get an OTP verification code to process flight payments no code was sent. This trigger "resend code" which I pressed - nothing received.  I then tried to make other payments and again no verification code was received from Mastercard or my bank. Mastercard alerted me to the fact it was trying to process payments but the SMS/OTP/verification would not go through Lebaras network. I contacted Lebara on Sunday 19th explained the problem asking it to be resolved urgently as I could not book my flights. By Monday my flights had increased by £60 with 3 seats left, I telephoned Lebara again and still the complaint was not escalated. On Tuesday I received a call from Lebara saying that because I was using my phone number as a business my account had been blocked! I had to send an email to confirm it was a personal account despite all the years I have had it. There was no urgency by Lebara to resolve this. In the meantime I could not access any online bank or any transactions. 
I have now changed my mobile service to another provider as I cannot trust this wouldn't happen again next month as I have no confidence in Lebaras customer service.  
Tonight over 48 hours later Lebara called to say the account had been blocked because I had tried to get OTP codes sent through - and would take no responsibility! An option appears when an OTP code does not come through to click RESEND which I did for the various purchases I was making. If Lebaras network had been working properly I should not have had to click RESEND the OTP. 
A credit of £30 has been offered which will not cover the increase in flights and hotel that I've incurred. I also asked that the complaint compensation be paid to my bank account and Lebara refused. I've had to change to another mobile provider as I cannot trust Lebara and their customer service has been lazy and non urgent. AVOID!
